column1: # French glossary. Claude-only proposal, drafted 2026-11-05 alone by Claude, pending the three-vendor debate; not final.

# Same columns as en.tsv: term holds the French, forms separated by " | ". Apostrophes are U+2019, as the style guide requires; the check matches them literally. Definitions are D3's where D3 changed them.

# Rows D3 retires stay, mapped to the chosen term, until D3 merges and en.tsv drops them. So do acceleration-eco and acceleration-turbo, which D3 makes do-not-translate: drop those two rows when it merges. D3's new rows (and renamed ids) wait in l10n/pending/glossary-d3/fr.tsv until then; the loader refuses ids en.tsv lacks.

# HOLD until D3 merges: en.tsv and the strings still use Top speed and Maximum speed in their old senses, while the top-speed and maximum-speed rows below already use D3's. Following those rows now would call the setting Vitesse de pointe and the measured value Vitesse maximale, the swap section 7 of the style guide forbids.

# So do not draft or merge these keys before D3: dashboard_model_tile_top_speed, controls_experimental_speed_limit, the readings_maximum_speed_kmh ladder (with _short and _compact), rides_tile_max_speed (English Max speed, a measured value; no row catches it, and D3 makes it Top speed, so Vitesse de pointe), and main_speed_* if they arrive first. They stay English (council verdict fallback). pack.py has no per-key filter, so a run over those areas must rule them out by hand. Other keys with these terms already match D3.

# untested-controls keeps the warning the English has today: more_lab_untested is Commandes non testées until D3 changes its English to Controls to try. It then goes stale and is drafted again from the controls-to-try row in l10n/pending/glossary-d3/fr.tsv, which d3-terms.md still marks for review.

# Term-check allowances, not wording advice; the style guide decides which form a string uses: try keeps réessayer and réessayez only so an ordinary "Try again" on a safety key passes (it is never Essayer); stop keeps immobiliser and immobilisez for "Stop the scooter", and à l’arrêt for "at a stop"; restore keeps Rétablir and its forms for NAVEE logging and for writing back a tested value; unconfirmed keeps non confirmé outside a try's status chip.
